newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp to bid for Thyssen - sources.
newsitem.headline: Krupp to bid for Thyssen - sources.

text.p: Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp will launch a takeover bid for the whole of or for a major stake in rival Thyssen AG, banking sources said on Tuesday.
The bid will probably be presented today, the sources said. No official confirmation was available immediately.
Thyssen said in a statement late on Monday that Krupp planned a hostile takeover and that it would use "all appropriate measures" to ward off any grab for control by its rival.
Thyssen has called a news conference for Tuesday afternoon. Krupp on Monday night declined comment but said it would issue a news release.
